items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: We had a trombone player who came in. His name was Banti.

ctx.x: Of course, the band changed personnel. At different periods, they had different guys come in. It changed. And I'd like to mention a couple of guys who were spectacular. You know, so many people got overlooked during that period, you know.
